fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Steam-Turbine Expansion with Wellhead Transient ODE
source: DiPippo, R. (2015). Geothermal Power Plants, 4th ed., Ch. 7 (Dry Steam Plants), Butterworth-Heinemann. Steam properties from IAPWS-IF97 (Wagner & Kretzschmar, 2008) simplified correlations.

unit.name: Generic Dry Steam Geothermal Plant — Physics-Lumped (The Geysers / Larderello class)

P_wh_design.note: Wellhead steam pressure design point (typ 0.5-1.0 MPa for dry-steam fields)

P_cond.note: Condenser pressure (~50 degC saturation, surface/direct-contact condenser)

T_superheat.note: Wellhead superheat above saturation; 0 = dry saturated steam

m_dot_steam_design.note: Design steam mass flow to turbine

ncg_mass_fraction.note: Non-condensable gas (mainly CO2) mass fraction in steam; 0.5-5% typical

w_ncg_extraction.note: Parasitic extraction work per kg NCG (steam-jet ejector / vacuum pump), DiPippo Ch.7

tau_wellhead.note: Lumped wellhead/turbine pressure-flow transient time constant
